source: ORCA 6.1.1, HF/def2-SVP single points with NoRIJCOSX TightSCF (RHF; UHF for triplet O2), on the geometries named (tests/references/dft/<name>.xyz; Br2 as Valence builds it, CIR, 2.26 A along x). Dipoles are ORCA's 'Total Dipole Moment' in atomic units (e bohr) about the coordinate origin. Run 2026-11-11 on this machine; inputs and outputs in ~/orca_calcs/hf-oracle/.
